title: Test Setup & Teardown - Per-Test Hooks
description: Configure test-level setup and teardown procedures that run before/after EACH test.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "Suite hooks run once for the whole suite. But what if each test needs its own preparation? That's where Test Setup and Test Teardown come in."
story.context: Test Setup runs BEFORE each individual test. Test Teardown runs AFTER each individual test. Perfect for resetting state between tests.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Perfect! Each test now gets its own clean environment. No test pollutes another test's state!"

theory.title: Exercise 2.1.3: Test Setup & Teardown
theory.content:
🔄 Individual Test Lifecycle

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, Suite hooks run once for the entire suite. But each test might need its own fresh environment."

"Test Setup runs before EACH test. Test Teardown runs after EACH test. If you have 5 tests, these hooks run 5 times each."

🔁 What are Test Hooks?

Test Setup - Runs BEFORE EACH test case

  • ✅ Reset application state
  • ✅ Navigate to starting page
  • ✅ Create fresh test data
  • ✅ Initialize variables

Test Teardown - Runs AFTER EACH test case

  • ✅ Clean up test data
  • ✅ Close browser windows
  • ✅ Reset database state
  • ✅ Capture screenshots on failure

📝 Test Lifecycle Example

*** Settings ***
Test Setup       Log    Test starting - preparing environment
Test Teardown    Log    Test finished - cleaning up

*** Test Cases ***
First Test
    Log    Running first test

Second Test
    Log    Running second test

Execution Order:

  1. 🔹 Test Setup: "Test starting - preparing environment"
  2. 🔹 First Test: "Running first test"
  3. 🔹 Test Teardown: "Test finished - cleaning up"
  4. 🔹 Test Setup: "Test starting - preparing environment" (again!)
  5. 🔹 Second Test: "Running second test"
  6. 🔹 Test Teardown: "Test finished - cleaning up" (again!)

📋 Test Hooks Rules

  • 🔹 Frequency: Run BEFORE and AFTER EVERY test case
  • 🔹 Syntax: Test Setup Keyword Arguments
  • 🔹 Difference from Suite: Suite runs ONCE, Test runs PER TEST
  • 🔹 Failure Handling: If Test Setup fails, that test is skipped
  • 🔹 Isolation: Each test gets a fresh setup/teardown cycle

🎯 Your Task

Create a suite with Test Setup and Test Teardown, then add TWO test cases. Watch the log - you'll see the setup and teardown run TWICE (once per test).
